coverage.reason: The live menu adds DispatchRoster Repeater Column Row rows so every public rat name plus objective and K/D is visible by default.
Silent alert baseline, failed-to-successful retry receipts, and XDG receipts must survive panel close without replaying missed notices.
Roster and alerts consume only the public companion feed and must never store reconnect credentials.
An open panel refreshes immediately and every two seconds with honest empty stale and live states.
Alerts must report disabled DND quiet 22-08 game-focus stale baseline and 15-minute cooldown on Omarchy 4.0.3.
KeyboardPanel focus, arrow scrolling, plain-text roster labels and 4.5:1 theme contrast remain required.
QtTest path is omarchy/plugin/tests/qml/tst_roster.qml; Node proofs use omarchyModel and omarchyDesktop suites.
Plugin 1.1.1 already hosts Repeater standings, silent baseline, and helper JSON DND or focus suppressions.

direct.name: Qt Quick
direct.compatibility: Matches the Omarchy 4.0.3 Quickshell host already verified with Qt 6.11.2 QtTest.
direct.ownership: Qt owns Repeater Column Row Flickable Timer and property bindings; Omarchy owns Panel KeyboardPanel chrome; the plugin owns DispatchRoster composition and theme tokens.

behavior.behavior: The 1.1.1 live menu already hosts KeyboardPanel Flickable plus Repeater DispatchProgressRow rows, but slices objectiveRows to three, hides K/D behind Combat totals, and labels capacity as slash 16.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy game HUD cards, or nest a TableView Flickable inside the existing panel scroller; TableView is only a rejected nested-scroller reference.

platform.requirement: Repeater instantiates Item delegates from the score model and is documented to live inside Column or Row positioners, so DispatchRoster binds name objective and K/D that way inside the existing KeyboardPanel Flickable.

proof: omarchy/plugin/tests/qml/tst_roster.qml binds public score rows up to the current 10-rat display cap and asserts every name, objective value and K/D pair is visible without incidentExpanded.
Assert an empty score model renders zero roster rows while DispatchStateBadge still shows empty or stale from the parent connection state.
Assert the room population label uses the current 10-rat gameplay cap and never renders a slash 16 suffix.
Existing tests/qml/tst_dispatchappearance.qml must still pass Omarchy and Rat Detective fonts plus 4.5:1 text contrast.

direct.name: Rat Detective Omarchy plugin
direct.compatibility: Keeps companion schema version 1, the 16-row safety bound, and the existing Service StatusModel poll path on Omarchy 4.0.3.
direct.ownership: StatusModel owns normalize freshness and alert math; Service owns poll baseline DND and receipts; the desktop helper owns notify JSON suppression; the hosted Worker owns the public projection.

behavior.behavior: alertEvents already suppresses disabled DND quiet hours game focus and stale snapshots, but skips rooms with no prior row so a newly appearing two-human room after silent baseline never fires.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy Omarchy notification chrome, mako styling, or any reconnect token into receipts or logs.

platform.requirement: A single-shot Timer restart after each poll owns the two-second open interval, and setPanelOpen true must call refresh immediately instead of waiting for the first timeout.

proof: Extend the imported StatusModel suite so a silent live or empty baseline followed by a newly appearing room with two humans emits exactly one gathering event.
Assert zero model events when alertsEnabled is false, context.dnd is true, isQuietHour uses 22 and 8, gameFocused is true, fresh is false, or filterAlertReceipts still has a 15 minute cooldown.
Assert a failed poll that clears the baseline followed by a successful retry writes a silent rebase and emits no gathering receipts for that recovered snapshot.
Assert normalizeRows and room humans keep the schema-compatible 16 safety bound and do not clamp the normalizer to the current 10-rat gameplay cap.
Add notify helper cases that parse JSON action suppressed-dnd and suppressed-focused and assert omarchy notification send is not invoked.
